Engineering

Transferencia de Combustible

The process of pumping fuel oil from one tank to another or to the engine, requiring strict adherence to MARPOL, safety, and spill prevention procedures.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Transferencia de Combustible?

In this glossary, Transferencia de Combustible refers to: The process of pumping fuel oil from one tank to another or to the engine, requiring strict adherence to MARPOL, safety, and spill prevention procedures.

How is Transferencia de Combustible used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Sala de máquinas, inicie la transferencia de combustible al tanque de sedimentación según el plan de suministro y confirme que todas las bandejas de derrames estén en posición."

Definition

The process of pumping fuel oil from one tank to another or to the engine, requiring strict adherence to MARPOL, safety, and spill prevention procedures.

Operational example

Engine room, commence fuel oil transfer to settling tank as per bunkering plan and confirm all spill trays are in position.
